lesson-03.hero_image_caption: Every media product begins with a client brief: the document that defines the audience, purpose and constraints that every creative decision must serve.

lesson-04.hero_image_caption: Every creative choice in a media product — from lighting and colour to font and camera angle — is a code that shapes how audiences read, feel and respond to the work.

lesson-05.hero_image_caption: Before a single frame is published, media creators must navigate copyright law, industry age-rating systems and ethical responsibilities to the audiences and individuals their products portray.

lesson-06.hero_image_caption: Pre-production documents such as mood boards and layout sketches help media creators plan their work before a single file is opened.

lesson-07.hero_image_caption: Storyboards, scripts and work plans are the pre-production tools that keep complex moving-image and audio projects on track from the first idea to the final deadline.
